instructions.instruction: Create a summary at the top of the Make a high level
Flag deleted functions or data types first.
Flag changed functions or data types second.
Flag new functions or data types third.
If there are incompatible changes, in a separate, detailed section, list the incompatiblities and suggest a porting strategy for the end user.
Suggest improvements to the Dockerfile, run.sh, and test.sh at the end of the report.
If any aditional data is needed, request it at the end of the report.

package-name:
the package name can be deduced from Dockerfile in the current directory.
For example. This line in a Dockerfile RUN dnf download -y hipblas --destdir=/a The package name is 'hipblas'
baseline-package: the Dockerfile installs production rpms from Fedora these files are installed to a/ in the docker image
test-package: the Dockerfile installs test rpms from a Fedora COPR these files are installed to b/ in the docker image

pkgdiff-layout.description: A directory structure for running containerized tests, building Docker images, and analyzing package differences (ABI, manifests, rpmlint, rpminspect).
pkgdiff-layout.base-dir-relative-to: The project root directory. Contains Docker build configurations, shell scripts for testing and running, and log files.

file.name: *.sh
file.desc: Executable shell scripts used for automation (run.sh for running, test.sh for testing).

directory.name: output
directory.desc: Subdirectory containing package diff artifacts, ABI dumps, manifests, linting reports, and execution logs.

file.name: *.manifest
file.desc: Package manifest files for packages 'a' and 'b' across different variants (original, devel, src).

file.name: *.rpmlint
file.desc: Output from rpmlint checking packages 'a' and 'b'.

file.name: *.rpminspect
file.desc: Output from rpminspect analyzing packages 'a' and 'b'.

file.name: *.abi-dump.dump
file.desc: ABI dump files comparing packages 'a' and 'b'.

file.name: docker-build.log
file.desc: Copied Docker build log for this specific run.

file.name: docker-run.log
file.desc: Copied Docker run log for this specific run.
